description: Fetches price, market cap, ATH/ATL and description for a coin by its CoinGecko coin ID (e.g. 'bitcoin', 'ethereum') or by ticker symbol (e.g. 'BTC', 'WAVES'). IDs are case-sensitive; a symbol, or an ID in the wrong case, is resolved by search and the response names the ID actually fetched, so a resolution is never silent.

coin_id.description: CoinGecko coin ID (e.g. 'bitcoin') or ticker symbol (e.g. 'BTC'). IDs are case-sensitive; symbols are resolved by search.

name: market_coin_details

id.description: CoinGecko id actually fetched (differs from the request when a symbol or miscased id was resolved)

title: Coin Details
